heading: Model assessments and review context

overall.basis: Strong, correct and inspectable specialist correction with explicit counterexamples and a properly scoped law theorem; modest depth and no demonstrated broad spectral-gap consequence.

technical.scale: Requested supplementary reviewer rating; not a separately defined official rubric field
technical.basis: All core claims survived exact algebra and controls; complete all-length arguments but elementary methods and an already established persistence ingredient.

importance.scale: Requested supplementary reviewer rating; not a separately defined official rubric field
importance.basis: Useful correction of a specific lemma and plausible misuse, without a main-theorem refutation, classification result or field-shaping advance.

minor_objections.finding: The three supplements are available and reproducible in the frozen packet, but the PDF does not bind all of them to immutable public file versions. This is not evidence that the public files are absent.
minor_objections.requested_action: Provide commit/file URLs, script names, dependencies and run commands; identify any cited reset verification artifact.

minor_objections.finding: Full-span persistence is already in source Lemma A.3; the positive theorem combines this with elementary inverse-base adjunction. The one-source bibliography provides limited novelty context.
minor_objections.requested_action: Attribute persistence and distinguish established ingredients from the periodic counterexamples and onset-law correction.

minor_objections.finding: The source uses A.1 in later appendix proofs, but the manuscript does not trace the affected dependencies or name A.9 explicitly. No counterexample to the main theorems is established.
minor_objections.requested_action: Name the affected appendix results and the limits of any repair; retain the current main-theorem disclaimer.

minor_objections.finding: Faithfulness is not explicitly defined; all channels used below is overbroad relative to the later reset; genuinely reversed can be confused with a normalized physical reversal; the one-step shift is an endpoint convention.
minor_objections.requested_action: Define faithfulness, restrict the bistochastic sentence to section 2, and clarify algebraic reversal and endpoint anchoring.

minor_objections.finding: The prior favorable component-audit summary is contextual exposure, not proof. Runtime identity, effort, isolation, underlying-model participation and independence remain unattested.
minor_objections.requested_action: Keep disclosures and bind assessment history to a separate immutable record; make no stronger independence or review claim.

effective_identity_effort_independence: Unattested; shared filesystem; prior component-audit summary disclosed in PDF. No human peer review or editorial acceptance. Limited model evidence.
admission: Single unverified model assessment does not establish founder-authored admission eligibility; Working paper only

response.status: Author response accompanying unchanged reviewed PDF; final report and integrity verified

M1.response: All three supplied supplementary scripts byte-match immutable public commit; Python3.12.14 and SymPy1.14.0. Copy scripts to writable scratch and run python each-script.py; scripts write output beside themselves. Reset example is proved algebraically in PDF; reviewer scratch control may be linked separately after final archive.

M2.response: Persistence is an established ingredient: source2607.01446v1 LemmaA.3,p35, directly inspected here. New contribution is scoped periodic counterexamples and temporal-law clarification, not a new general injectivity or Choi mechanism. Additional background identified by reviewer: Sanz etal arXiv0909.5347v2; Movassagh/Schenker1909.11769v4. Those additional works are not proof-audited by author in this response.

response.M3: A.1 is used downstream in A.7/A.8 according to source comparison in report. A.9 and main parent/gap results are not refuted or repaired here. Distributional identities require a compatible reversal convention and cannot replace pathwise identities without a new argument.
response.M4: Faithful means Phi(a)=0 for positive a implies a=0. Bistochastic/unital description applies to the bistochastic constructions section; the reset control is TP but not unital. Genuine reversal denotes the algebraic shifted-adjoint/inverse-base construction, not necessarily a TP physical reverse channel.
response.M5: Publish full report, exact PDF hash, provenance limitations, prior component audit and all objections in a separate version-specific assessment record. No verified model identity/effort/isolation/independence, human peer review or editorial acceptance is asserted.
response.scope: Accompanying clarifications do not change assessed PDF; minor wording/citation issues remain visible in original PDF. No numerical grade inferred or transferred to a new version.
response.minor_objections: M1-M5 retained in full original report; accompanying clarifications do not silently amend PDF
